recognize_zh: 高度細胞化的骨髓抹片以各階段顆粒球前驅細胞為主，其間散在數顆胞質豐富、呈淡灰藍色的大型組織球，符合慢性骨髓性白血病（CML）中的偽高雪氏細胞（pseudo-Gaucher cells）。
features: Markedly hypercellular aspirate dominated by granulocytic precursors at all stages of maturation (myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands)
Scattered large histiocytes with abundant pale gray-blue cytoplasm and small eccentric nuclei
Cytoplasmic fibrillary texture only faintly appreciable at this magnification; one histiocyte shows small vacuoles
No sheets of blasts in the field
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is markedly hypercellular with a predominance of maturing granulocytic elements, including myelocytes, metamyelocytes and band forms, without an increase in blasts in this field. Scattered among the myeloid cells are several large histiocytes with abundant pale gray-blue cytoplasm and small eccentric nuclei. The fine striated 'wrinkled tissue paper' texture is only subtly appreciable at this power. In the setting of CML, findings are consistent with pseudo-Gaucher cells reflecting increased cell turnover.

ddx.vs: Morphology is nearly identical, so separation relies on clinical context, glucocerebrosidase enzyme assay/GBA genotyping and the absence of a myeloproliferative background with BCR-ABL1.
Sea-blue histiocytes contain discrete blue ceroid granules rather than a finely fibrillar gray-blue cytoplasm.
MAC-laden histiocytes may appear striated but show negative-image rods and are acid-fast positive.
Megakaryocytes have a large multilobated nucleus and granular cytoplasm rather than a small eccentric nucleus.
